title: biscutella lyrata subsp. laxiflora
intro: Biscutella lyrata subsp. laxiflora, commonly known as Alpine Penny Cress, is a flowering plant species within the Brassicaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, helping to protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Penny Cress include its potential to alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues and its use as an expectorant to aid in cough relief. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include glucosinolates, which contribute to its medicinal properties and may provide protection against certain diseases.
